title: 06 — CHECKLISTS (per milestone)
summary: Per-milestone acceptance checklists covering implementation, review, QA, scientific validation, docs, hygiene, and release gates.
notes: Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences) and not user-story PRD. Content is verifiable acceptance criteria / gating contracts (coverage >=80%, schema equality, determinism, tolerance 1e-6) that the system must honor -> SPEC. Could be argued DOC as process guide; SPEC chosen because items are enforceable constraints referencing SPEC-01/SPEC-08 and REQ IDs.
